elements.title: ch1-courseEvaluations.xml with the First Three Entries Only, Opened with Visual Studio Code
elements.details: Screenshot of XML code showing the first three entries of CourseEvaluations.xml. The XML structure includes a root tag <Members>, containing three <Evaluation> blocks. Each <Evaluation> block has four child tags: <Semester>, <Instructor>, <Classsize>, and <Rating>. The values shown are: 1) Semester: Fall 2020, Instructor: A, Classsize: 100, Rating: Not recommended at all; 2) Semester: Spring 2021, Instructor: A, Classsize: 50, Rating: Highly recommended; 3) Semester: Fall 2021, Instructor: B, Classsize: 120, Rating: Not quite recommended.
elements.summary: This screenshot illustrates the XML format for listing dataset items, showing how each evaluation entry is structured with tags and values, demonstrating the hierarchical nature of XML for data representation.
